messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up on the Rate Bridge vs Quota Gateway split — RFC posted earlier had three options. TL;DR: we need a concrete contract for admission checks so the edge can fail fast without touching the quota-backend on every request.
Jon: Link?
Maria: https://redwood/rfcs/rate-bridge-bifurcation (draft)
SRE-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC
Alice: Proposed contract: RateBridge returns (admit | soft-decline | hard-decline) + optional reason + lease_id. soft-decline should include retry-after + degrade-tier so callers can gracefully degrade.
Kevin: I like lease_id. For KV cache correctness we need stable lease life > kvcache TTL (or we risk cache staleness).
Tim: Concern: where do abuse signals live? In RateBridge or QuotaGateway?
Maria: Abuse signals live in QuotaGateway, but RateBridge can carry an abuse_hint bit to request elevated scrutiny. Avoid coupling heavy scoring models into RateBridge.
Jon: Perf note: our benchmark showed ~12% p95 improvement if we avoid sync calls to quota-backend for warm leases. That matters for PLG latency SLOs.
Alice: Example response shape:
```
{ "decision": "soft-decline", "lease_id": "L-1234", "retry_after_ms": 1200, "degrade_tier": "cpu-shed" }
```
Kevin: Implementation plan (draft):
- Phase 1: RateBridge emits decision + lease_id; when ambiguous, edge falls back to QuotaGateway for final verdict.
- Phase 2: Introduce tokenized lease exchange to allow edge to validate locally (crypto-signed short-lived lease).
Maria: Ops question: observability — want per-decision metrics (counts by decision + reason), plus sample traces that include abuse_hint and lease_id.
Tim: SRE: we can add 1% sampling for soft-declines and full traces for hard-declines. Also need histogram of retry_after latencies.
Jon: Rollout plan: canary with 10% traffic pinned to new path, and rollout flag `rate_bridge.bifurcation.enabled`.
Maria: Agree. Also add escalation policy if p99 errors increase by >10%.
Alice: I'll open a follow-up PR with the proto, example code, and migration plan (edge SDK changes, runtime shim).
Kevin: +1
Tim: :thumbsup:
Maria: Thanks all — if no objections by EOD I'll merge the RFC and schedule a short sync with infra to coordinate canary config and staging deploys.
